verdict.topBlocker: Installation scope (Any workspace vs Selected workspaces only) is fixed at creation, so picking the wrong one means recreating the connection and re-issuing credentials.
verdict.summary: A public connection with Any workspace scope works over OAuth for any Notion user immediately with no required review. Marketplace listing (5-10 business days, security review) is optional; after install, the agent only sees pages each user shares, Enterprise admins can block or allowlist connections, and rate limits are about 3 requests/second.
verdict.reason: Guide put the optional Marketplace review into approvalWait and the topBlocker; Notion docs state public connections work via OAuth without listing, so required wait is 0 and difficulty drops to 2 (self-serve + app config). Also fixed misattributed 'cannot change' (scope, not redirect URI), missing owner=user, and unsupported privacy-policy requirement.

optionalPaths.name: Notion Marketplace listing (includes Notion security review)
optionalPaths.why: Products wanting discovery and trust signals in Notion's Marketplace; only Any-workspace public connections are eligible; docs state 5-10 business days for a response.
optionalPaths.evidence: https://developers.notion.com/guides/get-started/marketplace-listing.md - "Listing on the Marketplace is optional and helps your connection reach a wider audience"

optionalPaths.name: Approval on Enterprise customers' approved connections list
optionalPaths.why: Enterprise customers whose owners restrict installs must allowlist the connection themselves; timing depends on each customer's admin, not Notion.
optionalPaths.evidence: https://www.notion.com/help/add-and-manage-connections-with-the-api - owners can restrict which connections members install via an "approved connections list."

limits.impact: The agent can only read/write pages and databases the user picks (with full access) in the page picker or later via Add connections; nothing else in the workspace is visible.
limits.evidence: https://developers.notion.com/docs/authorization - "The page picker only displays pages or databases to which a user has full access"

limits.impact: One user's install does not grant access for teammates; each user in a workspace must run OAuth themselves.
limits.evidence: https://developers.notion.com/guides/get-started/public-connections.md - "each user needs to complete the authorization flow individually."

limits.impact: Enterprise workspace owners can restrict installs to owners or to an approved connections list, blocking members until an admin approves; a Marketplace listing is not stated as a bypass.
limits.evidence: https://www.notion.com/help/add-and-manage-connections-with-the-api - restrict "The ability to add connections" to workspace owners (Enterprise)

limits.impact: 180 requests/minute (avg 3/s) per connection on most plans, 600/min on Business/Enterprise; agents must honour 429 Retry-After with backoff.
limits.evidence: https://developers.notion.com/reference/request-limits - "180 requests per minute (an average of 3 per second)"

limits.impact: Each refresh returns a new access token and a new refresh token, so the agent must persist the newest refresh token atomically.
limits.evidence: https://developers.notion.com/reference/refresh-a-token.md - "generating a new access token and new refresh token"

limits.impact: Selected workspaces only cannot serve arbitrary customers and cannot be listed; use Any workspace for a multi-customer agent.

stepChanges.newTitle: Create a public connection with 'Any workspace' scope
stepChanges.newDetail: In https://app.notion.com/developers/connections create a public connection; set name, development workspace, redirect URI(s), capabilities and installation scope. Choose 'Any workspace' for a multi-customer product: scope cannot be changed later.
stepChanges.reason: Scope choice is the main irreversible decision; link updated to current portal URL.

stepChanges.newDetail: Add redirect URI(s) and choose capabilities (read/update/insert content, user info). Notion has no OAuth scopes beyond these capabilities. Copy client ID/secret from the Configuration tab.
stepChanges.reason: Guide wrongly said redirect URI cannot be changed (that applies to installation scope) and referred to scopes.
Notion docs do not require a privacy policy or ToS to create a public connection or a listing; good practice only.

stepChanges.newTitle: Implement OAuth authorization request and page picker
stepChanges.newDetail: Send users to https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/authorize?client_id=...&redirect_uri=...&response_type=code&owner=user&state=...; users pick pages to share.
stepChanges.reason: owner=user is required ('Always use user') and was omitted; link pointed at the API endpoint, not docs.

stepChanges.newTitle: Exchange code for tokens and handle refresh
stepChanges.newDetail: POST https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/token with Basic auth base64(client_id:client_secret), grant_type=authorization_code, code, redirect_uri. Store access_token and refresh_token; refresh with grant_type=refresh_token and save the new refresh token.
stepChanges.reason: Adds Basic auth and refresh-token rotation, omitted by guide.
Marketplace listing is optional; OAuth works without it.
Wait applies only to optional Marketplace listing (5-10 business days), not to OAuth readiness.

missing: owner=user is a required authorize parameter. https://developers.notion.com/docs/authorization
Token endpoint uses HTTP Basic auth and returns a refresh_token; refresh rotates both tokens. https://developers.notion.com/reference/refresh-a-token.md
Only 'Any workspace' public connections are Marketplace-eligible; scope cannot be changed after creation. https://developers.notion.com/guides/get-started/public-connections.md
Marketplace review response time is published: 5-10 business days. https://developers.notion.com/guides/get-started/marketplace-listing.md
Rate limit 180 req/min per connection (600/min Business/Enterprise); handle 429/529 with Retry-After. https://developers.notion.com/reference/request-limits
Enterprise owners can restrict connection installs to an approved connections list. https://www.notion.com/help/add-and-manage-connections-with-the-api
Each workspace member must authorize individually; access is limited to pages they share. https://developers.notion.com/guides/get-started/public-connections.md
